title: Guild Artisan
html:
Guild Artisan is a character background with skills and inspirations themed around crafting and mercantilism. The hireling Jacelyn has this background.

“
Your skill in a particular craft has earned you membership in a mercantile guild, offering privileges and protection while engaging in your art. Repairing and discovering rare crafts will bring new inspiration.
„

Background features

  • Insight Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with Wisdom (Insight) Ability Checks.
  • Persuasion Proficiency: Gain Proficiency with Charisma (Persuasion) Ability Checks.

Background goals

Performing certain actions that align with this background rewards Inspiration. These goals can be accomplished by any member of the active party, and Inspiration points are pooled, up to a maximum of 4. Completing an inspiration event also grants experience to characters with this background. While not necessarily all-inclusive, listed below are known events which grant inspiration points.

Location XP Reward Name Description
General
Anywhere 25 A Golden Masterpiece Sell an item worth at least 1000 gold.
20 Valued Customer Trade with someone who has High approval of you.
Act 1
Grymforge 30 Art Endures Craft something in the Adamantine Forge.
50 Expert Opinion Evaluate the ruins in Grymforge and share your findings with the duergar mason.
  • This is granted if all three checks ( Investigation,  History and  Perception, all DC 10) on examining ruins are passed by a single character. Any other party member starts an independent dialogue and has to pass their own sequence of checks.
  • The checks are not necessary passed in a single dialogue; a party member can try them separately until they use the dialogue option "I'm ready to report".
Forest 25 A New Vision Reforge the broken spear.
Riverside Teahouse 30 An Acquired Taste Drink one of Ethel's unique potions.
  • Heart of Stone or A Mother's Loathing are recommended, as the others have negative effects.
  • If not earned here, this inspiration can also be earned in Act Three in The Blushing Mermaid Basement, if Ethel resides there.
Underdark 30 Mind Over Mushrooms Gather ingredients for Omeluum's potion.
30 Regeneration Restore power to the elevator in the Arcane Tower.
30 The Finest Ingredients Create a masterwork item from Sussur Tree Bark.
30 Trash & Treasure Observe the effects of the Chest of the Mundane.
Waukeen's Rest 30 The Spider's Gift Identify the drow armour near Waukeen's Rest.
  • This requires the armour to be picked up with a Drow, Duergar, Deep Gnome, or any character with +5 to History or higher in the party.
Zhentarim Basement 30 An Artist in Need Rescue Oskar the painter from the Zhentarim.
30 In Working Order Repair the elevator in the Zhentarim Hideout.
Act 2
Gauntlet of Shar 75 Dark Machinations Fill all sockets with Sharran gems in the Gauntlet of Shar.
75 Made of Shadows Unlock and take the Spear of Rampant Night.
  • The relevant weapon is actually called the Spear of Night.
60 Mating Season Discover the source of the displacer beast's infatuation.
  • The party must investigate the spider carcass near Yurgir.
Last Light Inn 60 Hellish Armaments Obtain a piece of infernal equipment from Dammon.
50 In the Palm of My Hand Acquire the Brilliant Retort from Barcus.
  • This is the reward for completing the quest Rescue Wulbren.
Moonrise Towers 50 Blood, Sweat, and the Other Thing Give your blood to Araj Oblodra.
Moonrise Towers Prison 50 Simple Tools, Great Works Return Wulbren's tools to him.
  • This doesn't need to be his hammer that was confiscated; any bludgeoning weapon, including the club that Wulbren can pick up on the docks, will award this Inspiration.
Reithwin Town 60 Confiscated Works Acquire a magical item from the toll collector's confiscation chest.
60 Inhumane Trials Witness a horrid operation in the cursed house of healing.
60 Ruthless Craftsmanship Take Shar's ceremonial dagger.
  • This prompts a fight with hostile undead Dark Justiciars.
60 Safety-Averse Quaffing Drink at least 1 of the brewer's steins.
60 Special Iced Arsenic... Brew? Craft some Brewed-Up Bellyglummer.
60 Tragedy in Masonry Discover the fate of the mason.
Shadow-Cursed Lands 50 Trust and a Little Pixie Dust Investigate the Moonlantern and find its power source.
Act 3
Lower City 135 Extravagance Required Acquire an exquisite new outfit from Figaro's.
  • Granted only upon trading with Figaro Pennygood himself. Trading with Phlanders Hort if Figaro died does not count.
220 Flames of Passion Burn Oskar's painting with a Torch of Revocation.
170 Lantanna Marvel Take control of the Submersible.
  • Despite the description, convincing Redhammer to operate the submersible also grants the inspiration.
170 Putting the Pen to Paper Discover the inner workings of the Baldur's Mouth printing press.
170 Sanguine Progress Find out what happened to Araj and her blood experiment.
170 Soured Taste Find a bottle of poisoned wine at the wine festival.
220 The Art of Destruction Use the Runepowder Bomb to destroy the Steel Watch Foundry.
170 These Belong in a Museum! Open any of the special vaults in The Counting House.
170 Touring the Sights Correctly identify all of the Devil's Fee's relics.
  • Despite the description, it is enough to correctly identify any two of the highlighted items (of four total).
  • A  DC 15 Arcana Check is required to identify each one of the items. For Karlach, however, the check is DC 0 instead (a reliable way to obtain the inspiration).
Rivington 135 Dream Big Describe your perfect weapon to Gyldro Angleiron.
  • This is only possible if Orin is impersonating the smith, and granted only if the answer to her third question is "Perhaps. If there was no other option"[1]
  • It is not necessary for the Guild Artisan character to be the one talking to Gyldro.
135 Encouraging Local Artists Commission a Statue of yourself.
135 Free Advertisement Complete the interview with Lens.
170 Following the Instructions Return the Sentient Amulet to Shirra.
135 Immoral Ingenuity Discover the booby-trapped toys.
170 Macabre Enigma Piece the corpse of Dribbles back together.
Wyrm's Crossing 170 Alternative Vocations Partake in a service from Sharess' Caress:
  • Accept a free drink from Hoots Hooligan
  • Experience 'rapture' from Naoise Nallinto
  • Hire either Nym Orlith or Sorn Orlith or both

Cut Background Goals

The Apprentice Turns Master: Craft Nettie's antidote in the cauldron.

  • This source of inspiration was removed by Patch 1 when the quest Get Help from Healer Nettie was changed to use regular potion crafting to make an antidote rather than using the cauldron and Flora of the Dalelands to craft an Elixir of Silvanus.
